claim_text: RoPE rotates each absolute position, and the attention score depends only on the relative distance between the tokens.

spec.explain: Toy illustration for arXiv 2104.09864: two dials turn by m and n but only their gap matters. Watch score, the relative attention score, which falls as rel grows.

questions.q: Set m to 5 and n to 5 and watch score. Do you expect shifting m and n together to change it?
Set n to 2 and m to 4 and watch score
Set m to 4 and watch rel
Set n to 1 and watch score
